name: ComposeOverviewV1
steps: call LLD-03/05/06/07/08 project_overview providers with that same snapshot/window/scope
stream distinct communication-target refs from LLD-03/05/07 using the same snapshot/window/scope; deduplicate exact (target_type,target_id) while preserving deterministic owner/type/id order

compose CommunicationOverviewProjectionV1 through CommunicationOverviewAssembler using only LLD-09 CommunicationSummaryProvider.entity_summary on those distinct target refs; no Communication body/table access occurs
validate every provider contract version/result bound and communication aggregation bound
construct four cards in fixed order Tickets,Objectives,Inventory,SLA Health
compute TrendValueV1 only from owner-provided current/previous counts
merge owner AttentionItemV1 values and rank with NeedsAttentionRankingV1

merge bounded timeline/activity values using their deterministic order; Communication attention/activity comes only from LLD-09 summary coverage/proposal facts or owner-provided scoped target summaries
render at most eight narrative items through NarrativeRendererV1
return owner infrastructure projection, composed communication summary, provider coverage/freshness metadata and snapshot_as_of_utc
communication_aggregation: each distinct target ref contributes its LLD-09 entity-summary counts exactly once
same canonical Communication linked to multiple distinct entities may contribute once per distinct linked entity, matching BETA-REQ-0122; duplicate aliases/duplicate target refs never inflate
last interaction is latest known independently supported entity-summary chronology; scan/discovery/proposal time is never substituted

coverage combines conservatively: any unknown required contribution keeps unknown; partial dominates complete; unconfigured remains explicit; no-target scope yields not_applicable rather than zero-as-complete
fail_closed: communication target stream or LLD-09 summary contract failure -> OVERVIEW_PROVIDER_FAILURE rather than stale/zero substitution
rules: coverage unknown/partial/unconfigured remains data and does not become zero
Overview never queries rejected/deferred proposal rows as accepted facts
no provider or composition step may request Resolved Status Date
no write, job enqueue, audit insert or domain command occurs
all communication aggregation remains within the one shared read snapshot
